name: Elizabeth of Hungary
contribution: A princess of the Kingdom of Hungary and the landgravine of Thuringia.

checks.lead: Elizabeth of Hungary (German: Heilige Elisabeth von Thüringen, Hungarian: Árpád-házi Szent Erzsébet, Slovak: Svätá Alžbeta Uhorská; 7 July 1207 – 17 November 1231), also known as Elisabeth of Thuringia, was a princess of the Kingdom of Hungary and the landgravine of Thuringia.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
